kurz: Wine with spices heated gently, not boiled: that keeps the aroma, and most of the alcohol too.
bild_im_kopf: Like a teabag of spices in warm wine: steep it, yes; boil it, no.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Warm red wine with cinnamon, cloves, star anise, orange peel and sugar
schluesselmomente.warum: Many aroma compounds in the spices dissolve better in alcohol than in water.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Bring to about 70 °C and do not let it boil (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: Alcohol boils at around 78 °C. If the [[wein|wine]] boils, aromas escape along with the alcohol and it tastes flat.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Let it steep for 20–30 minutes, then remove the spices
schluesselmomente.warum: Cloves and cinnamon bark steeped too long release bitter, astringent compounds.

schluesselmomente.schritt: For children: grape juice instead of wine
schluesselmomente.warum: Even long simmering does not remove the alcohol completely. After 15 minutes around 40 % of it is still there (as a guide).
